subject: Re: Model mix & pricing follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jones <sara.jones@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing follow-up

Thanks again for taking the call this morning, Sara — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

Summary of what we heard:
- Primary use: patient triage chat (symptom intake + triage suggestions) and post-visit summarization.
- Secondary: embedding-based semantic search for clinical KB and a small reranking workload for candidate results.
- Success metrics: 95th pct latency < 600ms for chat, predictable cost / month, and data residency in US.

Open items we discussed (please confirm):
1) Monthly token volumes (rough): chat, embeddings, rerank — if you can confirm precise numbers that helps us size Dedicated vs Hosted.
2) Target unit economics: you mentioned a target $/1M tokens — can you confirm a target range?
3) Model mix preferences: any constraints on model family (open weights vs licensed), or must it be a verified/redwood-curated model?

Attachments sent: redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx (pricing scenarios), SOW-draft-v1.pdf, token-estimates.csv (template).

Next steps we propose:
- If you can reply with the per-workload monthly token estimates and a target $/1M tokens, we’ll run 3 pricing scenarios (hosted, mixed, dedicated) and share expected spend + latency tradeoffs.
- Schedule a 30m follow-up next week with our solutions engineer to walk pricing scenarios and caching/batching levers.

Thanks — looping in Nikhil to help build the pricing scenarios.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference
From: Sara Jones <sara.jones@nimbushealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing follow-up

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap. Below are the numbers I promised from our internal telemetry (monthly averages):

Estimated monthly token volumes (prompt+completion unless noted):
- Chat (patient triage + summaries): 200,000,000 tokens/month (70% of token volume)
- Embeddings (semantic search + similarity): 50,000,000 vectors/month (we estimate ~20M tokens equivalent for embed generation; ~20% of tokens)
- Rerank (candidate scoring): 30,000,000 tokens/month (10% of tokens)

Model mix (preferred):
- Chat: Redwood-Chat-13B (quantized) for most flows, fallback to Redwood-Chat-70B for complex summarization (expected ~10% of chat tokens)
- Embeddings: OpenEmbed-v2 (or equivalent open), high-recall vector dims 1024
- Rerank: small encoder model (Redwood-Rerank-3B)

Budget / unit economics: 
- Current procurement guidance: target ~$300 per 1M tokens (this is a hard target for our CFO for FY27).
- Monthly budget range we can approve initially: $5,000 — $12,000 (we are open to committing to higher commit if unit cost improves).

Notes:
- We are interested in a Dedicated/reserved option if it meaningfully reduces $/1M tokens and meets latency SLOs.
- We can share anonymized sample telemetry if that helps with more accurate sizing. Attaching our token-estimates.csv export.

Let me know when you can send the 3 scenarios. We prefer the follow-up on Thursday 18th 10–11am PT or Friday 19th 9–10am PT.

Best,
Sara Jones
Director of Product, Nimbus Health
sara.jones@nimbushealth.com

Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing follow-up

Sara — perfect, thanks for the details and the target of ~$300 / 1M tokens. A few clarifying Qs before we build scenarios: 
1) When you say chat tokens (200M) is that prompt+completion combined? (yes/no)
2) For the 10% of chat going to the 70B model, is that steady-state or bursty/spiky? If bursty, we may recommend a mixed routing + fallback to keep costs low.

What I’ll do next:
- Nikhil and I will run three scenarios and return a short one-page comparison (Hosted, Hybrid with caching, Dedicated reserve) showing estimated $/1M tokens, expected 95th-pct latency, and commit required to hit <$300 / 1M.
- Proposed follow-up: Thu 18 Jun at 10:00 AM PT (you indicated this works) — I’ll include our Solutions Engineer (Rishi) to walk the CPU/GPU sizing and caching options.

Attached: draft pricing scenarios we’ll refine (redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx) — initial pass is conservative.

Thanks — can you confirm Q1 above and if Thu 10am PT works?

Best,
Marissa
